title: Delete your Japa Coach account
intro: This applies to the website and the Japa Coach mobile app.
deleted: Your account, profile and login details
Your speaking recordings, transcripts, essays, answers, scores and reports
Your study plan and your review
note: Payment records (plan, amount, date and reference) are kept, without your name or email, as long as the law requires. Days left on a paid plan are lost. Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone.
steps: Log in below (or in the app, go to More, then Settings, then Delete my account).
fallback: Can't log in? Email hello@japacoach.com from your account's email address and we will delete it within 30 days.
